author: Steve Kuckuk
text: My experience suggests Bluetooth can be/is an imperfect technology . . . (Remember the Libra App needs to be open to work) It is typical that the connection can be lost from time to time particularly if the phone is sitting somewhere as you travel from room to room . . . Having too many Bluetooth devices connected to the device, or overuse of heavy data apps can also impact connectivity . . . In general it will correct itself and reestablish the communication between devices by itself sometimes in minutes, sometimes longer . . . Powering down the phone and starting it up again is really the only diagnostic I know of, short deleting and reinstalling the App itself  . . .  It should be noted that when the connection is restored, the missed data from the sensor transfers to the phone, meaning no actual data is lost.
